snippet.title: Liquidity without Counterparty Risk
snippet.description:
Liquidity Without Counterparty Risk – The Smarter Way to Protect Your Wealth

In uncertain times, where can you safely store your money without exposing yourself to counterparty risk? While bank accounts offer liquidity, they also come with risks—bank failures, compensation limits, and inflation eating away at your savings.

Gold and silver provide a liquid, real-world alternative to traditional banking. Unlike cash in the bank, physical gold isn’t dependent on financial institutions— it’s yours, free from third-party control.

Concerned about inflation? Gold has historically acted as a hedge, preserving purchasing power where fiat currencies fail.
Worried about bank stability? Gold isn’t tied to a banking system that can freeze accounts, limit withdrawals, or fail overnight.

In this video, we break down:

✔️ How gold and silver offer near-instant liquidity
✔️ Why banks come with hidden counterparty risks
✔️ The growing concern over financial system stability
✔️ How inflation impacts your savings—and how gold can help

Don’t wait for the next financial crisis. Discover how to secure your wealth with assets that don’t rely on banks.

snippet.title: Should I Buy Gold Vs Bitcoin?
snippet.description:
Should I Buy Gold vs Bitcoin? In this exclusive interview with Rob Moore, The Pure Gold Company explores the key differences between physical gold and cryptocurrency. Gold has been a proven store of value for thousands of years, offering security, tax efficiency, and long-term stability. Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, on the other hand, present high-risk, high-reward opportunities with extreme volatility, regulatory uncertainties, and security concerns. While blockchain technology is here to stay, the interview highlights how investors are increasingly using gold as a hedge against crypto market crashes. If you're weighing up gold vs Bitcoin for wealth protection or speculative gains, this video provides critical insights to help you make an informed decision.
Key Chapters Summary – "Should I Buy Gold vs Bitcoin?"
[00:00:00] Introduction: Gold vs. Crypto
 • Gold and cryptocurrency are two of the most polarized asset classes.
 • Gold is about safety, security, and wealth preservation.
 • Crypto, particularly Bitcoin, is more about speculation and high-risk gains.
 • 
[00:00:30] Taxation and Regulation
 • Gold allows tax-free portfolio growth.
 • Cryptocurrencies now face increasing regulations and taxation.
 • More crypto regulations are expected in the future.

[00:00:50] The Role of Blockchain
 • The technology behind cryptocurrency, blockchain, is seen as valuable and here to stay.
 • While blockchain will evolve, cryptocurrency markets remain highly volatile.

[00:01:10] Crypto Volatility & Risk
 • Many people believe investing in crypto will make them instant millionaires.
 • However, crypto can lose up to 70-80% of its value within short periods.
 • Even Bitcoin, the most secure cryptocurrency, has seen massive fluctuations.
 • Many investors panic-sell during crashes, locking in their losses.
[00:02:00] Security Risks in Crypto
 • Crypto assets face risks like hacks, forgotten passwords, delisting of platforms, and lost access to wallets.
 • Gold investors typically avoid these risks, valuing physical security.
[00:02:40] A Strategic Approach to Crypto Investing
 • Some investors take a calculated risk approach by only investing what they can afford to lose.
 • Many diversify by using gold as a hedge against crypto losses.
[00:03:20] The Performance of Gold vs Crypto
 • When Bitcoin dropped 70-80%, gold doubled in value over the same period.
 • This trend suggests gold serves as a stabilizing asset in times of crypto crashes.
[00:03:40] Smart Wealth Protection
 • Many investors who made big gains in crypto failed to secure profits.
 • A wise strategy is to diversify into gold as Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies rise.
 • This approach locks in gains and reduces overall risk.

snippet.title: Russian gold coin with a dark history behind it
snippet.description:
Russian gold with a dark chapter of history behind it.

Today at Gold Knox, we’re looking at 5, 10, and 15 Ruble Russian gold coins, including the 15 Ruble featuring Czar Nicholas II, the last Emperor of Russia.

Nicholas II ruled during one of the most intense turning points in Russian history. After the Russian Revolution, he abdicated the throne in 1917, ending centuries of Romanov rule. Less than two years later, in July 1918, Nicholas II, his wife, children, and close household members were ☠️ by the Bolsheviks in Yekaterinburg.

That’s what makes coins like this so fascinating. They are not just gold coins. They are pieces connected to the final years of Imperial Russia, the fall of a dynasty, and a story that still captures collectors over 100 years later.

If you have old world gold, inherited coins, or foreign currency sitting around, bring it to Gold Knox and let us take a look.

🧠 Dr. Susanna Søberg (@susannasoeberg ) enlightens neuroscientist Andrew Huberman about the transformative effects of cold showers, immersion, and cold air exposure, potentially revolutionizing health practices 🚿❄️

👩‍🔬 Dr. Søberg, with a Ph.D. in metabolism, merges science and health, sharing groundbreaking insights. Her extensive research identifies optimal durations for cold and heat exposure—11 minutes of cold and 57 minutes of heat per week for maximum health benefits

🌡️ Andrew David Huberman, neuroscientist and podcast host (@hubermanlab ), embraces this knowledge. Together, they're reshaping perceptions and harnessing the power of cold and heat experiences 🔬💪

🔄 This collaboration could redefine our approach to well-being, creating a balanced and informed perspective on the benefits of cold and heat exposure 🌐🌬️
